summary: Longevity Health Holdings, Inc. (formerly Carmell Corp), a Pittsburgh-based specialty company, filed an 8-K on September 4, 2026, disclosing entry into a Securities Purchase Agreement with existing investor Puritan Partners LLC on August 31, 2026. Under the agreement, the company issued a 10% Senior Secured Convertible Note in original principal amount of $416,667 (with 10% original issue discount) for $375,000 in cash, to be used for working capital subject to a settlement agreement with Puritan and Carmel Regen Med Corporation dated August 13, 2026. The Note matures February 29, 2028, bears 10% cash interest, is convertible at $0.50 per share, with an alternative conversion price of 80% of the five-day VWAP if below the conversion price, and includes a 4.99% beneficial ownership limitation. The agreement contemplates two additional tranches (up to $138,889 each) subject to conditions including an effective registration statement. This is a distressed financing rather than a special situation, so no deal terms are captured. Watch for further tranche issuances and conversion activity.
